visual_review.target_subject: single premium serum bottle product image
visual_review.summary: The image is a clean, credible single serum bottle proof with strong runtime evidence value. It is not yet a commercial production candidate because the bottle is generic, the composition leaves too much unused upper space, and the label/brand surface is absent.
strengths: single serum bottle identity is clear
gold dropper cap and frosted glass body are legible
clean studio lighting supports a beauty product route
no fake logo, fake text, hands, people, or extra bottles
artifact evidence is complete with sha256, mime, and dimensions
watch_items: large upper whitespace makes the product feel undersized for a hero product frame
bottle body has no label panel or brandable surface, so it reads generic
glass depth and shoulder detail are acceptable but not yet premium delivery quality
file extension remains .png while artifact mime is image/jpeg; downstream should trust mime/evidence over extension
commercial delivery and production candidate promotion require a separate review gate
